title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Computer Science - Software
subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Software that controls the basic operations of the computer hardware is called:
questions.explain: System Software (like the Operating System) manages hardware resources. Application software performs user tasks.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of an Operating System?
questions.explain: Windows 10 is an OS. Word is a word processor, CorelDraw is graphics software, Firefox is a browser.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: What is the function of 'Application Software'?
options: To perform specific tasks for the user
questions.explain: Application software (apps) is designed to help the user perform specific tasks like writing (Word) or calculating (Excel).
questions.subject: Computer Science
